title: High-intensity interval training along with spirulina algae consumption and caloric restriction ameliorated the Nrf1/Tfam/Mgmt and ATP5A1 pathway in the heart tissue of obese rats.
authors: Yousefian, Mahboobeh; Taghian, Farzaneh; Sharifi, Gholamreza; Hosseini, Seyed Ali
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨运动、热量限制和螺旋藻对肥胖大鼠心脏Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT通路的影响，仅涉及少量分子对接预测，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT and ATP5A1 might be a pivotal network in cardiovascular disease-inducing obesity. Therefore, we evaluated eight weeks of exercise, caloric restriction, and spirulina algae consumption on the heart in obese rats. In this study, obese rats were compared with a healthy group. First, we induced obese rats with a 60%-high-fat diet. Then, after eight weeks, obese rats were randomly divided into eight groups: obese rats without treatment (HFD), obese rats treated with spirulina algae (HFD-SA), obese rats conducted exercise (HFD-EX), obese rats treated with spirulina algae and exercise (HFD-SA+EX), obese rats treated with caloric restriction (HFD-CR), obese rats treated with caloric restriction and exercise (HFD-CR+EX), obese rats treated with spirulina algae and caloric restriction (HFD-SA+CR), and obese rats treated with SA+CR+EX (HFD-SA+CR+EX). Also, the exercise protocol was performed for eight weeks, three sessions per week at an intensity of 80%-110% of maximum running speed. The spirulina algae were consumed by gavage (100 mg/kg/day), and caloric restriction used 60% of the food consumed. We found that SA+CR+EX significantly modified the Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT and ATP5A1 network in cardiovascular disease-inducing obesity rats (p < .01). Moreover, we predicted SA could be bound to Tfam and MGMT protein targets. Hence, exercise, caloric restriction, and spirulina algae had a synergistic effect on mitochondrial biogenesis in the heart tissue of obese rats (p < .01). PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS: According to artificial intelligence and medical biology servers, we discovered that mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative stress are dominant phenomena in the cardiovascular system. Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT and ATP5A1, as pivotal regulators of oxidative stress, could play an utmost important role in the cardiovascular disease-inducing obesity molecular pathway. Furthermore, several studies have indicated that environmental factors such as the western diet and physical inactivity disrupted the mitochondrial dynamic, which led to increased reactive oxygen species (ROS). We predicted the binding power of the Spirulina's small molecules on Tfam and Mgmt proteins based on drug-discovery technology and pharmacokinetic parameters. Considering oxidative stress and mitochondrial machinery related to the action of some molecular pathways, mitochondria-related nuclear-encoded proteins, and ROS, this study evaluated the high-intensity interval training, caloric restriction, and spirulina consumption on heart mitochondrial biogenesis in obese rats. Our data might provide a novel strategy for the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease-inducing obesity.
abstract_zh: Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT 和 ATP5A1 可能是心血管疾病诱导肥胖中的一个关键网络。因此，我们评估了八周的运动、热量限制和螺旋藻摄入对肥胖大鼠心脏的影响。在本研究中，将肥胖大鼠与健康组进行比较。首先，我们通过60%高脂饮食诱导肥胖大鼠。然后，八周后，将肥胖大鼠随机分为八组：未治疗的肥胖大鼠（HFD）、螺旋藻治疗的肥胖大鼠（HFD-SA）、进行运动的肥胖大鼠（HFD-EX）、螺旋藻治疗并运动的肥胖大鼠（HFD-SA+EX）、热量限制治疗的肥胖大鼠（HFD-CR）、热量限制并运动的肥胖大鼠（HFD-CR+EX）、螺旋藻和热量限制治疗的肥胖大鼠（HFD-SA+CR），以及SA+CR+EX治疗的肥胖大鼠（HFD-SA+CR+EX）。此外，运动方案进行了八周，每周三次，强度为最大跑步速度的80%-110%。螺旋藻通过灌胃摄入（100 mg/kg/天），热量限制使用食物摄入量的60%。我们发现，SA+CR+EX显著改变了心血管疾病诱导肥胖大鼠中的Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT和ATP5A1网络（p < .01）。此外，我们预测SA可能结合到Tfam和MGMT蛋白靶点。因此，运动、热量限制和螺旋藻对肥胖大鼠心脏组织中的线粒体生物发生具有协同效应（p < .01）。实际应用：根据人工智能和医学生物学服务器，我们发现线粒体生物发生和氧化应激是心血管系统中的主导现象。Nrf1/Tfam/MGMT和ATP5A1作为氧化应激的关键调节因子，可能在心血管疾病诱导肥胖的分子通路中发挥极其重要的作用。此外，多项研究表明，环境因素如西方饮食和缺乏身体活动会破坏线粒体动态，导致活性氧（ROS）增加。我们基于药物发现技术和药代动力学参数预测了螺旋藻小分子对Tfam和Mgmt蛋白的结合能力。考虑到与某些分子通路作用相关的氧化应激和线粒体机制、线粒体相关核编码蛋白以及ROS，本研究评估了高强度间歇训练、热量限制和螺旋藻摄入对肥胖大鼠心脏线粒体生物发生的影响。我们的数据可能为心血管疾病诱导肥胖的预防和治疗提供一种新策略。
